13:G2  A habit's target repeats every period until the habit ends (end_date) or is archived.
27:    habits (409); description <= 500; note <= 280; at most 50 active (non-archived,
123:- `habits`: `id` (a client UUID), `user_id`, `name`, `description` (nullable), `target_count`, `period` (`week` | `month` | `year`), `start_date`, `end_date` (nullable), `archived` (default false), `version` (starts at 1), `change_seq`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `deleted_at` (nullable).
135:- A habit's target applies again in every period, from the period containing `start_date` until the period containing `end_date` (or for ever when `end_date` is null); archiving does not change the periods, it only stops nudges and check-ins.
139:- `POST /v1/habits` takes `{id, name, description?, target_count, period, start_date?, end_date?}` (`id` a UUID the client generated) and answers 201 with the habit `{id, name, description, target_count, period, start_date, end_date, archived, version, created_at, updated_at}`; `archived` is false and `version` is 1.
145:- A habit name is unique among the user's non-deleted habits, archived or not, compared case-insensitively (`Run` and `run` conflict); a duplicate on create or on rename answers 409 with code `name_taken`. Another user may use the same name.
146:- A user has at most 50 active (non-archived, non-deleted) habits; creating one more answers 409 with code `habit_limit`.
148:- `GET /v1/habits` answers `{items, next_cursor, has_more}` with the caller's non-deleted, non-archived habits ordered by id; `?include_archived=true` includes archived ones.
150:- `PATCH /v1/habits/{id}` takes `{version, ...}` with any subset of `{name, description, target_count, start_date, end_date, archived}` and answers 200 with the updated habit, its `version` one higher; the same validation as creation applies.
159:- `archived: true` archives the habit and `archived: false` restores it; restoring when the user already has 50 active habits answers 409 `habit_limit`.
173:- Creating or deleting a check-in on an archived habit answers 409 with code `habit_archived`.
219:- `GET /v1/home` answers `{today, habits, nudges}`: `today` the user's local date; `habits` every non-deleted, non-archived habit of the caller ordered by id, each the habit's normal body plus `progress` equal to its `GET /v1/habits/{id}/progress` body; `nudges` the caller's active nudges as a plain array (not paginated), the same nudges `GET /v1/nudges` lists, ordered by `habit_id`.
229:- No nudge is ever created or rewritten for a deleted or archived habit, a habit that has not started, or a habit whose `end_date` is before the user's today.
245:- `GET /v1/nudges` answers `{items, next_cursor, has_more}` (default page 50, maximum 200, as every list) with the caller's active nudges ordered by `habit_id`: those with `for_date` = the user's today, `dismissed_at` and `deleted_at` null, and a non-archived habit; each item as `{id, habit_id, for_date, kind, message, delivery, delivery_reason, dismissed_at}`.
